name: genesys-demo
title_zh: 在自有 Genesys Cloud 租户里搭演示对象
tagline_zh: 给已有虚拟客服搭演示用例，不用另开沙箱、不污染生产数据。自动生成对象、按场景编排，让销售或验收当场看到效果。
tagline_en: Build demo scenarios around your existing virtual agent, inside your own org. No sandbox, no prod pollution—just.
desc_en: Genesys Demo: build a use case or the demo objects around an existing virtual agent, in your own Genesys Cloud org
why_zh: 它把「演示」变成租户内的一等公民：对象按用例生成、可反复重置，演示完不留垃圾数据。
why_en: Treats demos as first-class citizens: generates objects per use case, resettable, and leaves no junk behind. Way faster than.
limit_zh: 只认 Genesys Cloud 官方 API 和已有虚拟代理；不负责画对话流、不生成语音/消息通道配置。对象建好后。
limit_en: Requires existing virtual agent and Genesys Cloud API access. No flow designer, no channel setup. Demo script is on you. Fails hard outside org scope.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Spin up demo objects in your own Genesys Cloud org
